newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JANUARY 21-THURSDAY, JANUARY 30.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, JANUARY 21-THURSDAY, JANUARY 30.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, JANUARY 21

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-334/95 Krueger: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 804/68 of June 27, 1968, on the common organisation of the market in milk and milk products, and in particular of its annex as amended by regulation 374/92 providing no export refunds on milk in food stuffs based on coffee essences or extracts although they are granted for milk in coffee-based foodstuffs. Consequences of a possible invalidity. Interpretation of Council regulation 2913/92 of October 12, 1992, laying down the Community Customs and Excise code. Deferral of execution of a customs decision. Application of export refund. - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-353/95-P Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission: state aid. Appeal against court judgment of September 18, 1995, in case T-471/93, Tierce Ladbroke v/ Commission. Refusal to annul Commission decision of January 18, 1993, rejecting the complaint of claimant under EC treaty articles 92 and 93. - Oral procedure joined cases C-359/95-P, C379/95-P Commission v/ Ladbroke Racing: competition. Appeal against court judgment of September 18, 1995, in case T-548/93, Ladbroke v/ Commission. Annulment of Commission decision of July 29, 1993, rejecting Ladbroke Racing Ltd's complaint. Bets on horse races. Pari mutuel urbain.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 22

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-322/95 Iuriaro: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 15, paragraph 1 (1) of Council regulation 574/72 of March 21, 1972, setting down application measures for Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU and of article 9a of regulation 1408/71. Base period for the granting of an invalidity pension. Worker having received an unemployment allowance in a member state where the law allows, in consequence of this, an extension of the base period. Request for an invalidity pension presented in another member state that does not provide for such an extension. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-45/96 Bayerische Hypotheken-und Wechselbank: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 1 of Council directive 85/577/EEC of December 20, 1985, on the protection of consumers in cases of contracts negotiated outside commercial establishments. Notion of "consumer". A security contract under German law subscribed to by an individual, acting on his own behalf, as coverage for a bank loan granted to a third person. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-63/96 Skripalle: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 27 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. National dispensatory measures aimed at countering fraud and tax evasion. Applicable rate on transactions between closely linked parties. Rent that is normal but inferior to costs incurred to render the service.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-269/95 Benincasa: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 13, paragraph 1, 14, paragraph 1 and 17, paragraph 1 of the Brussels Convention. Competence in matters of consumer contracts. Notion of consumer. Franchise contract concluded with a view to a future professional activity. Prorogation of competence. Arbitration convention. Recourse aimed at recognising the invalidity of the contract including a prorogation of competence cause. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-354/95 Farmers Union: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9 of Commission regulation 3887/92 of December 23, 1992, laying down application measures for an integrated system of management and checks on certain Community aid policies. Cases where the areas claimed by operators in requests for "area" aid are more than 20 percent superior to the areas determined during inspection. Refusal of aid. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-398/98 Syndesmos ton en Elladi Touristikon: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 59 and 60. National regulation that considers that the link between tourist guides and travel agencies falls necessarily under work law. - (1630/1530 GMT) Oral procedure C-154/96 Wolfs: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 29, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters. Old age benefit. National law setting a flexible pension age for men and women. Manner of calculating benefit different for men and women.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment T-115/94 opel Austria v/ Council: external relations. Annulment of Council regulation 3697/93 of December 20, 1993, withdrawing tariff concessions in accordance with article 23, paragraph 2, and article 27, paragraph 3 (a) of the Free trade Agreement between the EU and Austria (General Motors Austria). EEC/Austria accord. Consultation mechanisms and settling of disagreements. Compatibility of aid with the accord. EEA accord. Ban on customs tariffs. Applicability of regulation 2423/88 - GATT Compensation procedures.
THURSDAY, JANUARY 23

COURT OF JUSTICE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-246/95 Coen: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 173, fifth line. Appeal deadline. Possibility of extending deadline following a decision under national jurisdiction finding an irregularity in the action by a national authority that could have influenced an action that could be subject to an appeal under EC treaty article 173. Regularity of a recruitment procedure for temporary Commission agents by a call for candidates made to various permanent member state delegations.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-153/95 ANDRE: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 8, paragraph 2 (b), of Commission regulation 926/80 of April 15, 1980, on exemption from the application of compensation in certain cases. Export of products to which the new MCM applies. Export of goods imported less than six months previously.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion joined cases C-94/95, C-95/95 Bonifaci: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation and validity of article 4, paragraph 2 of Council directive 80/987/EEC of October 20, 1980, on the approximation of member state legislation on protection of salaried workers in cases of employer bankruptcy. Obligation to pay with security institutions. Faculty for member states to fix limits. Breach by a member state of obligation to transpose a directive. Obligation to pay damages. Means and conditions. - Opinion C-261/95 Palmisani: principles of Community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 5. National law regulating deadlines for the introduction of an action for damages resulting from rights confered on particulars in the case of a late transposition of a directive. Less favourable deadline than those applied on a similar action in internal law. - Opinion C-300/95 Commission v/ United Kingdom: environment and consumers. Non respect. Incomplete transposition of Council directive 85/374/EEC of July 25, 1985, on the coordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions in matters of responsibility for faulty products and in particular of article 7(e) of said directive. Provisions of internal law less strict than those of the directive. - Opinion C-347/95 UCAL: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9, 12 and 95 and of article 33 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. National tax on milk products affecting national production and imported products intended for the Portuguese intervention body. (page 1/2 - Monday-Tuesday)
HIGHLIGHTS

BRUSSELS - EU foreign affairs ministers meet (Monday); open debate on Dutch EU presidency, review of WTO ministerial meeting in Singapore (morning session); inter-governmental conference (afternoon session).
BRUSSELS - EU farm ministers meet (Monday); main discussions focus on Council regulation modifying rules for granting aid to linen and jute.
BRUSSELS - EU Monetary Committee meets (Tuesday); main discussions focus on third stage of EMU.
BRUSSELS - European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Marin meet Guatemala President Alvaro Arzu - followed by a news conference on future EU-Guatemala relations (Tuesday).

BRUSSELS - Inter-American Development Bank and the European Commission meet (Tuesday-Wednesday); discussions focus on future assistance to Guatemala. European Commissioner Marin gives opening address on Tuesday; closing news conference (Wednesday).

BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Wednesday); European Commissioner Van Miert holds news conference on green paper on vertical restraints and the start of the second stage of a competition investigation into Coca Cola's purchase of British bottler CCSB.
BRUSSELS - Colombian Foreign Minister Nohemi Sanin Posada on official visit (Thursday-Friday) - holds news conference on the outcome of her visit (Friday).
PRETORIA - South African government presents report to EU on trade and economic cooperation (Friday).

AMSTERDAM - Dutch EU presidency hosts conference on inter-governmental conference (IGC) and the EU Dutch presidency (Saturday); Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and European Commissioner van den Broek attend.
MONDAY, JANUARY 20
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - General Affairs Council.
Agenda includes:
- (0930/0830 GMT) Dutch presidency programme (open debate).
- Transatlantic relations.
- Trade questions - follow-up of WTO Ministerial Conference in Singapore - WTO negotiations on basic telecommunications.
- Preparation of the EU-ASEAN Ministerial meeting (Singapore).
- Preparation of the EU-ASEM Ministerial meeting (Singapore).
- Mediterranean policy: Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Palestinian Authority, Syria.
- Middle East peace process.
- Former Yugoslavia.
- Great Lakes region.
- Belarus follow-up on proposal for an EU fact finding mission.
- (1530/1330 GMT) Inter-governmental conference - exchange of views with EP President Jose Maria Gil-Robles, MEPs Elmar Brok and Elisabeth Guigou.
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Farm Council (1500/1400 GMT).
Agenda includes:
- European Commissioner Fischler report on the common organisation of the tobacco market COM(96)554.
- Proposal for Council regulations:
- Establishing an identification and registration system for beef;
- On labelling of beef and beef products.
- Proposal for Council regulation modifying regulation 619/71 fixing general rules for granting aid to linen and jute.
- State of work of the negotiations with third countries for the conclusion of veterinary and plant health equivalence accords.

- Adoption in Community languages of Council directive modifying directive 77/93/EEC on protective measures against the introduction into member states of harmful organisms in vegetables or vegetable products.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioners Van Miert and Wulf-Mathies meet Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi at 1200/1100 GMT - followed by a news conference with Commissioner Wulf-Mathies at 1800/1700 GMT.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner van den Broek meets EU Mediator for Cyprus Carey Cabanaugh.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Monti meets WTO Director General Renato Ruggiero.
TUESDAY, JANUARY 21
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU Monetary Committee meets (1000/0900 GMT). Main discussions focus on third stage of EMU.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and the European Commission meet (and Wednesday); discussions focus on future assistance to Guatemala. European Commissioner Marin gives opening address. Venue: Borschette Centre.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Marin meet Guatemala President Alvaro Arzu - followed by a news conference on future EU-Guatemala relations at 1100/1000 GMT.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Sabena Chief Executive Paul Reutlinger addresses the European Aviation Club, holds lunchtime meeting (1230/1130 GMT). Venue: Amigo Hotel. Contact: The European Aviation Club (322) 633 6030.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Association of European Chambers of Commerce and Industry (Eurochambre) holds news conference on "How will companies in the European regions perform in 1997?" (1100/1000 GMT). Venue: Eurochambre, 5 rue Archimede. Contact: Eurochambre (322) 230 0850.

BRUSSELS - Confederation of Belgian Industry holds lunch debate with WTO Director Renato Ruggiero (1215/1115 GMT). Venue: Confederation of Belgian Industry, 4 rue Ravenstein. Contact: Christine Legrand (322) 515 08 26.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on "Future relations between the EU and the ACP countries" (1315/1215 GMT). Speaker is European Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds round table on "Euro-Mediterranean partnership in the energy sector: making cooperation work" (1230/1130 GMT). Agenda includes: EU-Mediterranean energy cooperation - achievements so far; how the Meda programme can enhance private investment. Speakers include: MEP Umberto Scapagnini. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3956.
BRUSSELS - Institute for International Research holds conference on "Euro-Countdown" (0845/0745 GMT). Venue: Hotel Sheraton. Contact: (322) 762 6614.

BRUSSELS - Transatlantic Policy Network (TPN) holds conference on "NATO/EU enlargement: priorities and problems" (1730/1630 GMT). Speakers include: European Commissioner van den Broek and U.S. Ambassador to NATO Robert Hunter. Venue: EP. Contact: TPN (322) 230 6149.
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 22
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (0900/0800 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:

- European Commissioner Van Miert communications on green paper on vertical restraints; decision to extend block exemption regulation on exclusive purchasing agreements; decision to start second stage of competition investigation into Coca Cola's purchase of British bottler CCSB; notice on agreements of minor importance not covered by Articles 85 and 86 - followed by a news conference. - European Commissioner Monti communication on the decision to revise the regulation on VAT on telecoms services to cover non-EU firms.
- European Commissioner Fischler communication on olives and olive oil.
- European Commission President Santer and Commissioner de Silguy communication on the Commission's organisation for introduction of the euro.
- European Commissioners Wulf-Mathies, Bangemann and Flynn communication on cohesion and the information society.
- European Commissioner Bjerregaard communication on environmental questions - orientation debate.
- European Commissioners Brittan and Marin communication on the follow-up to the ASEM meeting - action plan.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission and EP present their new year wishes to the Belgian royal family.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet (times to be confirmed):
- Environment - European Commissioner Bjerregaard attends;
- Civil Liberties - European Commissioner Gradin attends;
- Institutional Affairs - European Commissioner Oreja attends.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Inter-American Development Bank and the European Commission meet (second of two days) - followed by a closing news conference at 1730/1630 GMT. Venue: Borschette Centre.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Norwegian Prime Minister Thorbjoern Jagland meets NATO Secretary General Javier Solana (1455/1355 GMT). Venue: NATO.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on "Should EU environmental policy have a future?" (1315/1215 GMT). Speaker is MEP Ken Collins. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
THURSDAY, JANUARY 23
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer meets Northrhein Westfalia Land Minister President Johannes Rau.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - EP Committee Inquiry into Fraud in Transit meets (0900/0800 GMT).

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Colombian Foreign Minister Nohemi Sanin Posada on official visit; meets European Commissioner Marin at 0930/0830 GMT; meets European Commissioner van den Broek at 1030/0930 GMT; meets EP President Jose Maria Gil-Robles 1500/1600 GMT (and Friday).

BRUSSELS - European Institute for Public Affairs and Lobbying (EIPAL) holds academic session (1800/1700 GMT). European Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro gives address on "The European agenda before the new century". Venue: Hewlett Packard Auditorium, 102 Blvd de la Woluwe. Contact: EIPAL (322) 481 7301.

BRUSSELS - Grant Thornton and CCH Editions Ltd hold joint news conference on "EU cross-border trade made easy" (1430/1330 GMT). Venue: International Press Centre (IPC). Contact: Heidi Lambert (322) 732 5546.

BRUSSELS - Forum Europe holds conference on "What rules for Europe's transport revolution - State aids and codes of conduct for the civil aviation, ports, shipping, road and rail sectors" (0915/0815 GMT). Agenda includes: towards a new EU procedural rulebook; defining the role on state aid; can the EU streamline its decision-making appeals procedure?; what rules for privatisations and other national transport policies? Speakers include: European Commissioner Kinnock; Swiss Ambassador to the EU Alexis Lautenberg. Venue: Concert Noble. Contact: Roberta Bonometti (322) 736 1430.

BRUSSELS - Conference Board Europe holds conference on "Towards a sustainable society - The sound use of science, risk assessment and cost/benefit principles in risk management". Topics include: the role of science and risk assessment principles in environment policy and decision making in general and in the EU in particular and the risks of risk communication. Contact: Chris Savage, Conference Board Europe (322) 675 5405.

LEUVEN, Belgium - European Centre for Public Affairs holds conference on "EMU: the public affairs agenda" (To January 24). Venue: Faculty Club. Contact: Amanda Brewerton, European Centre for Public Affairs (44) 1865 735422.
AMSTERDAM - Dutch EU presidency hosts conference on social policy and economic performance.
FRIDAY, JANUARY 24

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Colombian Foreign Minister Nohemi Sanin Posada meets European Commissioner Fischler at 1030/0930 GMT; holds news conference (1100/1000 GMT) at the Colombian ambassador's residence, 77a avenue Franklin Roosevelt.
PRETORIA (NEW ITEM) - South African government presents report to EU on trade and economic cooperation.
SATURDAY, JANUARY 25

AMSTERDAM (NEW ITEM) - Dutch EU presidency hosts conference on inter-governmental conference (IGC) and the EU Dutch presidency (0930/0830 GMT). Speakers include: Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and European Commissioner van den Broek. Venue: Beurs van Berlage.
SUNDAY, JANUARY 26
No events scheduled.
